resources.string: Auto-clicks the wireless-ADB trust popup on boot so no user action is needed.
Enable wireless debugging on this device
Monitors network & settings to automatically keep Wireless ADB active
Wireless ADB is disabled. Enable it above to listen for connections.
WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS is not granted. This permission is required to enable wireless ADB and auto-configure accessibility. Connect the device via USB to a computer and run:
adb shell pm grant eu.project_simple.adbautoenable android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

The auto-click accessibility service is disabled. It is required to automatically dismiss the Meta Quest trust dialog on boot.\n\nMetaOS hides standard accessibility settings. You can open the AOSP settings window or run the ADB command below:

adb shell "settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services eu.project_simple.adbautoenable/eu.project_simple.adbautoenable.AdbPopupAccessibilityService && settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1"
Auto-configuration failed. Ensure WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS is granted or use the ADB command.
